title: SQL FCI acl: server logins + roles + AD groups
description: The nexus-cli acl verb for the SQL Server FCI: list server principals (SQL logins, Windows logins, AD groups) + their fixed-server-role memberships.

observe.what: the operator nexus-cluster-admin (SQL_LOGIN, sysadmin), sa, NEXUS\\Domain Admins (sysadmin), and the NT SERVICE\\* logins

whatProves: acl surfaces the instance security: SQL logins + Windows logins + AD-group principals and their server-role grants; grant/revoke manage fixed-server-role membership.
